Football Coaches Resign, Probes Ordered After World Cup Exits

Several national football teams have seen their coaches resign following early exits from the FIFA World Cup. In South Korea, the president has ordered a probe into the team's performance, with reports of public anger and threats. Other nations like Saudi Arabia and Scotland also experienced coaching changes after failing to advance.
